title: Load the Projects page with one query
description: The Projects page joins owners and open-task counts in one query instead of two per project. No visible change intended.

steps.text: Open Projects. Ten projects list their owner and open tasks.
Open Cedar Ridge Wind. Its five open tasks are listed.

verdict.why: A genuine improvement: 23 SQL queries become 3, the page looks the same.

questions.question: How many projects does the after Projects page list?
